title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines, managing cloud infrastructure across multiple providers, and ensuring high availability and security.
The ideal candidate is a automation-first mindset engineer who is comfortable working with containerized microservices and has experience deploying AI models in serverless environments.

Key Responsibilities:
1. CI/CD Management: Design, build, and maintain efficient CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or GitHub Actions.
2. Containerization & Orchestration: Manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestrate them using Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) .
3. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement and manage infrastructure using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Ansible.
4. Cloud Operations: Architect and maintain solutions across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
5. Monitoring & Observability: Set up comprehensive monitoring and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or Datadog.
6. Monitoring & Observability: Set up comprehensive monitoring and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or Datadog.
7. Security (DevSecOps): Integrate security into the DevOps lifecycle, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
8. Scripting & Automation: Develop automation scripts using Bash, Python, and PowerShell to eliminate repetitive tasks.
9. Deployment Strategies: Implement Blue/Green and Canary deployments to ensure zero-downtime releases.
10. AI/ML Deployment: Deploy AI models and utilize cloud-provided models within serverless cloud infrastructure.
11. Collaboration: Work closely with Development and QA teams within Agile/Scrum frameworks to ensure smooth releases.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
1. Experience: 5+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles.
2. Cloud Mastery: Deep hands-on experience with at least two of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
3. Orchestration: Strong expertise in Kubernetes cluster management and service mesh technologies like Istio or Linkerd.
4. Configuration Management: Proficiency in Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
5. Version Control: Expert knowledge of Git, GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
6. Architecture: Experience in Disaster Recovery planning and designing High Availability architectures.
7. Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
